fichas.title: Track radii and rolling-stock turnability
fichas.summary: Guidance for track-centre-line curve radii by railway use, narrow-gauge track gauge, and rolling-stock axle base. Radii under 100 m should be avoided where possible on new construction. The page also notes operating limitations for carriages on tighter curves.

fichas.title: Track cant ramps and transition curves
fichas.summary: For tracks used at greater than shunting speed, a transition curve is to connect the straight section and circular arc. The transition curvature increases constantly; circular curves may be canted, and cant and transition curves should coincide. A table gives R, l, m, and ramp-gradient entries for branch lines and normal sidings.
uses: Provide transition curves between straight track and circular arcs
Coordinate track cant ramps with transition curves

fichas.title: Points, crossings and traversers
fichas.summary: Reference information for railway points and related trackwork, including warning-sign track-centre spacing, point and blade lengths, turntable diameters, traverser sizing, and a table of point-set radii, pitch ratios and overall lengths. Drawing symbols identify point types and track equipment.
uses: Specify and lay out railway points and crossings
Check point-set dimensions and track clearances
